segments.source: The standard Velasca is a front-access automatic for someone who wants more grinder adjustment while keeping milk manual. Ten ceramic-grinder positions, strength and temperature settings, adjustable preinfusion and a removable brew group give it useful flexibility behind the simple monochrome interface. The pannarello remains a separate steaming step, so this is not the carafe-equipped Prestige. There is also an identity limit worth keeping visible: the current North American product page confirms the pannarello model without exposing the RI suffix used in this route. The delivered plate and seller documentation should settle that detail before purchase.
